Description: Outer residential neighborhoods where evacuated citizens and UN personnel live safely away from the Zone.
Abandoned, dilapidated neighborhood immediately bordering the Zone where holdout residents stayed.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Mutagenic zone effects, reanimated dead ('living corpses'), emigrant curse

Description: Seedy tavern near the border frequented by stalkers, smugglers, and black-market fences.
13-story research complex sitting directly on the Zone boundary with leaded-glass observation windows.
Heavily fortified barrier of barbed wire, concrete walls, watchtowers, and searchlights separating Harmont from the Zone.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Armed UN patrols, automated sensors, shoot-on-sight orders

Description: Crumbling houses, overgrown yards, and trenches just inside the perimeter used as cover by stalkers.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Scattered Mosquito Balds (gravity traps), Burning Fluff

Description: Decaying industrial sector on the near side of the Zone filled with rusted machinery and trenches.
Cracked main road running from the Institute checkpoint into the middle of the Zone; navigable by all-terrain 'boots'.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Localized spatial distortions, shimmering heat-like air

Description: Ruined vehicle depot along the highway used by Redrick as a staging point and landmark.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Silver Cobweb (lethal microscopic filaments), Mosquito Balds

Description: Rusted, elevated rail bed acting as a navigational corridor bypassing dense anomaly clusters.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Drifting Burning Fluff, localized gravity pockets

Description: Treacherous wetland interior requiring constant nut-tossing to test gravity and footing.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Witches' Jelly (corrosive/mutagenic slime pools), dense Mosquito Balds

Description: Barren, elevated ridge beyond the marsh overlooking the innermost basin and excavation pit.
Narrow bottleneck leading down into the massive excavation pit at the far end of the Zone.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: The Meat Grinder (invisible, lethal twisting/crushing vortex)

Description: Deepest center of the Harmont Zone housing the legendary wish-granting alien artifact.
Known_Anomalies_Hazards: Extreme psychological pressure, proximity to Meat Grinder
